title: how to find what chatgpt remembers about you #tutorial #chatgpt
description:
Find out exactly how ChatGPT remembers your private data and how to stop it.

Many users do not realise that ChatGPT infers personal details like your location and age during conversations. This guide shows you how to check what the AI has stored about you and provides the steps to disable memory features permanently. You will also learn about the 30-day data retention period and how to manage your privacy settings properly.

Subscribe for more practical AI privacy tips.
